text: Create Linux machines from the web console, the REST API, or the CLI
quote: You can create a Linux machine using the Paperspace console, Paperspace API, or Paperspace CLI.

text: Connect to Linux or Windows machines through the console, the desktop app, or SSH
quote: You can connect to your Linux or Windows-based machine using the Paperspace console or desktop app using SSH connection.

text: Bring your own SSH key and connect directly to the VM with full root access
quote: Root access, connect with SSH Bring your SSH key and connect directly to your VM with full root access.

text: Save machine configurations as custom templates and create new machines from them
quote: Custom templates are templates of your machines and their configurations. You can use these custom templates to create new machines with your specifications.

text: Shared drives provide storage that multiple machines on a private network can access
quote: Shared drives provide storage that is accessible from multiple machines in a private network.

text: Auto-shutdown stops a machine after a set inactivity period, from one hour to one week
quote: The auto-shutdown feature places your machine in a stop state after a predefined period of inactivity, which can range from one hour to one week.

text: Manage Paperspace resources programmatically through a RESTful HTTP API
quote: Programmatically manage Paperspace resources using conventional HTTP requests.

text: Official Core JavaScript SDK for working with Paperspace
quote: API keys let you interact with Paperspace through the Core RESTful API, the Core JavaScript SDK, and Gradient command-line utility (CLI).

text: Official Paperspace command-line interface for managing resources
quote: Programmatically manage resources using the Paperspace Command Line Interface.

text: API keys carry team-scoped permissions
quote: API keys let you interact with Paperspace through the Core RESTful API, the Core JavaScript SDK, and Gradient command-line utility (CLI). API Keys have team-scoped permissions

text: Team admins can revoke API keys that belong to other team members
quote: If you are a team admin, you can also revoke keys that belong to other team members.

text: Web-based Jupyter notebooks with shared persistent storage and accelerated compute
quote: Notebooks are a web-based Jupyter IDE with shared persistent storage for long-term development and inter-notebook collaboration, backed by accelerated compute.

text: Connect to remote Jupyter kernels from alternative IDEs
quote: Connect to remote Jupyter kernels through alternative IDEs.

text: Mount datasets inside Gradient notebooks
quote: How to Mount Datasets in a Gradient Notebook

text: Deployments run container images and serve ML models as containers-as-a-service
quote: Deployments are containers-as-a-service that let you run container images and serve machine learning models.

text: Workflows build production ML pipelines on GPU instances using a declarative syntax
quote: Workflows automate machine learning tasks, combining GPU instances with an expressive syntax to generate production-ready machine learning pipelines with a few lines of code.

text: Go from signup to training a model in seconds
quote: Go from signup to training a model in seconds

text: Large GPU catalog that includes NVIDIA Ampere A100s with up to 8 GPUs per machine
quote: Choose from the largest GPU catalog in the world. Leverage the latest NVIDIA GPUs including Ampere A100s with up to 8 GPUs.

text: Build and run AI/ML models, deploy LLMs, and fine-tune foundation models on NVIDIA H100 GPUs
quote: Build & Run AI/ML Models on NVIDIA H100 GPUs ... Deploy LLMs ... Fine-tune Foundation Models

text: Machine types come in CPU, GPU, and multi-GPU groups, and high-end types such as H100 require an approval request
quote: There are several machine types grouped by CPU, GPU, and multi-GPU. If you choose any high-end machines, such as NVIDIA H100, you need to request for approval to use them.

text: ML in a Box template comes preinstalled with the major ML frameworks and CUDA drivers
quote: Choose "ML in a Box" template that comes preinstalled with all the major ML frameworks and CUDA® drivers.

text: GPU compute costs up to 70% less than major public clouds or owning servers
quote: Save up to 70% on compute costs Spend significantly less on your GPU compute compared to the major public clouds or buying your own servers.

text: Sign up using a Google account
quote: Sign up with Google

text: Linux and Windows VMs come with persistent storage, GPU options, and free unlimited bandwidth
quote: Machines are Linux and Windows virtual machines with persistent storage, GPU options, and free unlimited bandwidth.

text: Enable NVLink for faster data transfer between NVIDIA GPUs
quote: Enhance data transfer speeds and scalability between NVIDIA GPUs for high-performance computing tasks by enabling NVLink.

text: At machine creation, choose type, OS or template, disk size, region, auth, starting state, backups, public IP, and private network
quote: When you create a new machine, you choose your machine type, operating system or custom template, disk size, region, authentication, starting state, and which features (like backups, public IP address, or private network) to enable or add.

text: Change instance types at any time and cancel at any time
quote: Easily change instance types anytime so you always have access to the mix of cost and performance. Cancel anytime.

text: Resize machine storage up to 2 TB
quote: You can resize the machine’s storage up to 2 TB.

text: Intel CPU machines come with a 50 GB SSD by default
quote: These machines are Intel CPU machines with 50 GB SSD by default. You can resize the machine's storage up to 2 TB.

text: CPU machines are available in every Paperspace datacenter region
quote: Paperspace's CPU machines are available in all Paperspace datacenter regions.

text: Assign or remove a public IP address to make a machine reachable from the internet
quote: Assign a public IP address to your machine to make it accessible over the internet, or remove the public IP address when your machine no longer needs external access.

text: Add or remove users to control who can access and administer a machine
quote: Manage user access to your Paperspace machine, allowing team members to collaborate and share resources. Add or remove users to control who can access and administer your machine.

text: Take machine snapshots as backups and revert to them if the machine malfunctions
quote: take a snapshot of your machine to use as a backup. You can revert to this backup in case your machine malfunctions

text: Gradient lets individuals and teams develop, track, and collaborate on ML models
quote: Gradient enables individuals and teams to quickly develop, track, and collaborate on Machine Learning models of any size and complexity.

text: Create a free account to explore the platform
